title: CLA DB landing page
brief: Landing page for @clatech/db (CLA DB), a minimal Apache 2.0 fork of RxDB 17.6.0. Spanish copy (user decision). Primary direction: faithful replica of the user's reference site cla-db.lonemerit8.chatgpt.site (artboard 04), sans-serif headlines with monospace accents, dark scheme, brand pink and isometric stack illustration. Artboards 01-03 kept as earlier alternatives.

artboards.title: Terminal hero
artboards.tradeoff: Code-forward and developer-credible; lighter emotional pull and no feature grid

artboards.title: Gradient split hero
artboards.tradeoff: Strong visual brand with a live reactive demo; marketing feel over density

artboards.title: Dense docs-first
artboards.tradeoff: Most informative: changelog, feature grid, roadmap and CTA band; less dramatic

artboards.title: Replica espanol
artboards.tradeoff: Faithful recreation of the user's reference site (hero 'Tus datos, local-first', isometric stack illustration, stack bar, cards); Spanish copy; below-fold sections inferred from fork facts pending user screenshots
